use_cases: Landing page hero section with interactive flowing ribbon background
Product page visual enhancement with mouse-responsive wave effects
Portfolio or creative website with engaging canvas animations
Interactive brand experience with ripple disturbance effects
SaaS dashboard background with subtle animated elements
ai_summary: A sophisticated canvas-based animation component featuring flowing ribbon effects with real-time wave propagation. The component tracks mouse movement and creates ripple disturbances on interaction, producing organic, fluid visual motion. Configurable background and line colors with adjustable animation speed make it versatile for creative landing pages and interactive brand experiences.
